cases.title: Inter-VLAN Routing - Router Subinterface Down
cases.problem: PC0 cannot communicate with the server in VLAN 30.
symptoms: PC0 can successfully ping its gateway 192.168.10.1.
PC0 cannot ping the server at 192.168.30.10.
Ping to 192.168.30.10 results in 100% packet loss.
Router reports the VLAN 30 subinterface as administratively down.

show_commands.show_ip_interface_brief: GigabitEthernet0/0.10 192.168.10.1 up up; GigabitEthernet0/0.30 192.168.30.1 administratively down down
show_commands.show_vlan_brief: VLAN 10 USERS: Fa0/1; VLAN 30 SERVERS: Fa0/2
show_commands.show_interfaces_trunk: Gig0/1 is trunking with 802.1q; VLANs 1,10,30 are allowed and active

cases.root_cause: GigabitEthernet0/0.30, the router subinterface for VLAN 30, is administratively shut down.
evidence: Switch Fa0/2 is correctly assigned to VLAN 30.
Switch Gig0/1 is correctly trunking VLAN 30.
PC0 can reach VLAN 10 gateway but cannot reach the VLAN 30 server.
cases.expected_result: GigabitEthernet0/0.30 should show up/up and PC0 should successfully ping 192.168.30.10.

cases.title: Wrong VLAN Assignment
cases.problem: PC0 cannot communicate correctly because its switch port is assigned to the wrong VLAN.
symptoms: PC0 should belong to VLAN 10 USERS.
FastEthernet0/1 was incorrectly assigned to VLAN 30 SERVERS.
PC0 cannot communicate correctly with the intended VLAN 10 network.

show_commands.show_vlan_brief: VLAN 10 USERS: Fa0/1; VLAN 30 SERVERS: Fa0/2
show_commands.expected_configuration: Fa0/1 should be assigned to VLAN 10.
show_commands.fault: Fa0/1 was incorrectly assigned to VLAN 30.

cases.root_cause: FastEthernet0/1 was configured as an access port in VLAN 30 instead of VLAN 10.
evidence: Fa0/1 was found in VLAN 30 in the faulty configuration.
PC0 is intended to be part of VLAN 10 USERS.
Fa0/2 correctly belongs to VLAN 30 SERVERS.
cases.expected_result: Fa0/1 should appear under VLAN 10 USERS and PC0 should regain the expected network connectivity.

cases.title: Wrong Default Gateway
cases.problem: PC0 cannot communicate with devices outside its local subnet because its default gateway is incorrectly configured.
symptoms: PC0 can communicate with the local gateway interface 192.168.10.1.
PC0 cannot reach the server at 192.168.30.10.
PC0 is configured with an incorrect default gateway.
The configured gateway is 192.168.10.254 instead of 192.168.10.1.

show_commands.show_ip_interface_brief: GigabitEthernet0/0.10 192.168.10.1 up up; GigabitEthernet0/0.30 192.168.30.1 up up
show_commands.show_vlan_brief: VLAN 10 USERS: Fa0/1; VLAN 30 SERVERS: Fa0/2
show_commands.show_interfaces_trunk: Gig0/1 is trunking with 802.1q; VLANs 1,10,30 are allowed and active

cases.root_cause: PC0 has an incorrect default gateway configured as 192.168.10.254.
evidence: The router gateway for VLAN 10 is 192.168.10.1.
PC0 is configured to use 192.168.10.254 as its default gateway.
The switch VLAN and trunk configuration is operational.
cases.expected_result: PC0 should use 192.168.10.1 as its default gateway and successfully communicate with 192.168.30.10.
